description: Hold the Line: briefing, radio calls and outcome text.

briefing: {client} has a picket cruiser, the {flagship}, holding the approach to {system} while the {station} evacuates its dependants. {enemy} knows it and is coming in waves. Keep the {flagship} alive until the lanes clear. Expect fighters first, then something heavier.
Command wants the {flagship} still in one piece when the relief column arrives. {enemy} will try to cut it down in stages. Fly cover, break up the bombing runs and do not wander off after kills.
The {flagship} cannot manoeuvre and cannot retreat. That makes you its escort. {enemy} has fighters and at least one frigate nearby. Hold {system} until relief arrives.
success: The relief column drops out of the gate with the {flagship} still firing. {client} pays your fee and logs the {flagship}'s captain buying you a drink as a formality.
The line held. {enemy} pulls back and {client} pays out for {captain}, with a note that the {flagship} will need a month in dock.
Relief arrives to find the {flagship} scarred and afloat. {client} considers the contract met.
failure: The {flagship} is gone and the picket with it. {enemy} holds the approach to {system}. {client} will pay for the attempt only in condolences.
Nothing is left to hold. {client} cancels the contract and files the loss under things to discuss later.
radio-opening: Contacts at long range, fighters, six of them. Hold formation on the {flagship}.
Picket to all ships: {enemy} fighters inbound. Weapons free.
{captain}, they are coming straight for the {flagship}. Get in front of them.
radio-flagship: {flagship} here. We are staying put. Keep them off our hull.
This is the {flagship}. Turrets are warm. Do your part.
radio-bombers: Bombers! Four of them, coming in behind us. Stop them before they release.
Radar shows heavy fighters on a bombing run. Break them up.
Bombers on the {flagship}'s stern. Nobody is covering that side. You are.
radio-frigate: Large contact, jumping in on the starboard side. It is a frigate and it has brought friends.
{enemy} frigate on our flank. Its guns will outrange ours. Kill it or the {flagship} dies.
Frigate inbound. All ships, change of plan: hit the frigate.
radio-relief: Relief column is through the gate. Hold on, {flagship}.
This is Relief. We have you on scope. Two frigates, six fighters, all yours.
